Run notebooks, create Spark clusters, build streaming jobs.

Distributed processing with Spark SQL, DataFrames, and MLlib.
⑪ 𝐄𝐱𝐩𝐥𝐨𝐫𝐞 𝐌𝐢𝐜𝐫𝐨𝐬𝐨𝐟𝐭 𝐅𝐚𝐛𝐫𝐢𝐜

⑫ 𝐁𝐮𝐢𝐥𝐝 𝐑𝐞𝐚𝐥 𝐏𝐫𝐨𝐣𝐞𝐜𝐭𝐬

ai_analysis.summary: This is a promotional event post advertising a free Azure Data Engineering masterclass. It presents a brief 13-step roadmap naming SQL, Azure storage and database services, Azure Data Factory, Azure DevOps, Azure Key Vault, data warehousing, Python, Databricks, Delta Lake, Apache Spark, Microsoft Fabric, projects, and resume/interview preparation, followed by a schedule, registration links, and broad learning and career claims. The supplied text appears to be an excerpt and gives marketing-level descriptions rather than substantive technical explanations or code, so it does not support useful technical interview questions.
